name: carousel
description: A carousel with an optional heading and repeatable slide items (image, image alt, richtext), rendered either as a dark thumbnail slider with prev/next arrows and an overlay panel (instruments) or as a single image-beside-text panel with a specs list (split).

contentPattern.structure: Optional row 0 is a heading; each subsequent row is one slide with an image cell and a text cell (eyebrow, title, description); instruments variant builds a stage plus a clickable thumbnail rail, split variant shows one slide
